content.short: OpenSea Stream API provides real-time updates on events in the OpenSea marketplace for developers.
content.description: OpenSea Stream API delivers real-time events from the OpenSea marketplace through an NFT API tool introduced in beta on May 6, 2022. It emits event alerts for sales, listings, transfers, and offers on an item, providing developers with timely data to power apps that require current marketplace activity. Use cases include push notifications for new bids and live dashboards to monitor price movements, traded volume, and other trend indicators.
